IPCC: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), in its Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) on climate change, states that global greenhouse gas emissions, using 2019 as the baseline year, must be reduced by 43% by 2030 and by 84% by 2050. The charts on this site apply a linear projection based on IPCC targets for the periods 2019–2030 and 2030–2050, calculating annual target values for each year within these intervals.
PNNL: The Green Citizens' Action Alliance, in collaboration with the Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), completed the **Low Emission Development Strategy for Taiwan** research report. According to the model proposed in the study, Taiwan’s manufacturing sector, using 2019 as the baseline year, should reduce emissions by 50% by 2030 and achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. The charts on this site apply a linear projection based on PNNL’s manufacturing sector targets for the periods 2019–2030 and 2030–2050, calculating annual target values for each year within these intervals.
BASE_YEAR: The purpose of setting a baseline year is to provide a consistent basis for comparing the carbon reduction performance of different companies. The Net-Zero Pathway Simulator uses 2019 as the baseline year, aligning with the standard established by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC).
BAU_TITLE: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Baseline / Business As Usual (BAU)
BAU: BAU (Business As Usual) refers to "the changes in emissions from various greenhouse gas sources without implementing any emission reduction measures." The Net-Zero Pathway Simulator estimates emissions based on the average rate of change in emissions over the past four years.
COMMITMENT: Referring to the data from the Market Observation Post System – [Greenhouse Gas Emission and Reduction Information](https://mops.twse.com.tw/mops/web/t152sb01), the company's carbon reduction targets are presented after being standardized with 2019 as the baseline year.
